rows.name:
Combining all Noponjaa survey results,
we found the exact Golden Shroom coordinates-mo!
Once all return, we take our bodyguards treasure hunting-mo~

Tsukuku swimming in the lake is pretty-mo!
Tsukuku surveys skilfully: very, very pretty-mo!
Tsukuku's mirror shows the prettiest Tsukuku again today-mo.

Mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo-mo~ Survey done; Dodora found bird people!
Dodora followed them secretly, to Imperial Capital Achamoooth!
Dodora wants to make a headdress from their feathers-mooooo!

First expedition made Rutoru nervous-mo~
Spicals pestered Rutoru because Rutoru is cute.
What a pain-mo~ But the survey was done properly-mo!

Sky Mole: Found what look like wings on its back-mo.
It squeaks "kyupi" if you try to force them open-mo.
Green Feris: Strong legs, seems to jump well-mo.

> Captain: I've run out of stake paint-mo~
Surely the team can at least supply stake paint-mo—
Please reimburse this paint with travel funds-mo. End of report.

Survey done safely, so Nanana declared resolve-ssu-mo!
Nanana: 5 years surveying! Gold Licence Exam at last-ssu-mo!
Full marks or bust-ssu-mo! Gotta get fired up-ssu-mo!!

Somebody, somebody, somebody help-moo! Survey's done, but—
Hachocho's good-luck charm is go-go-gone-moo!
Without it, Hachocho×△◎※!mo□#~~~~~~~~

Noino fulfilled the "Mission"; then that wretch appeared-mo.
Noino used the last of that "Power" to drive the wretch off-mo—
But in return, Noino's "Proof" was sealed away-mo.

The rocks on "Pillar Knoll" had beautiful curves-mo!
Survey done; now test monster-repelling incense-mo.
If it works, I'll tell the other members about it-mo!

A survey ends once Shiishii has snacked and gone home-mo.
Today's snack: Shiishii's recommended Morrow Cob-mo~!
The kernels are so sweet and yummy-mo~

I felt I'd forgotten something as I surveyed-mo.
I don't know where to meet-mo! The others must be stuck too-mo.
Captain forgot to tell us again-mo. Unini shares the blame-mo—

The Golden Shroom was dried up, but
we got our hands on lots of treasures-mo~
Now we can rebuild the Ruins Research HQ-mo. Thanks all-mo~!
